grammar.summary: 本课围绕记者核实数字被逮捕展开，运用过去完成时叙述「先于过去」的委派与逮捕，并用 Not only...but...as well 倒装句突出记者的遭遇；同时以分词短语 leading to、surrounding 作后置定语使长句紧凑。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: had + 过去分词表示「先于过去某动作发生」的动作。本课中「记者受委派写稿」先于「稿子寄到」，「记者被捕、被送进监狱」先于「传真寄到」，故分别用 had been instructed、had been arrested、had been sent。

examples.en: Last year a journalist had been instructed by a well-known magazine to write an article on the president's palace in a new African republic.
examples.cn: 去年，一位记者受一家有名的杂志的委托写一篇关于非洲某个新成立共和国总统府的文章。

examples.en: Not only had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison as well.
examples.cn: 那个可怜的记者不仅被捕了，而且还被送进了监狱。

points.title: Not only...but...as well 倒装 (Inversion with Not only)
points.explanation: Not only 置于句首时，其后的主谓需部分倒装（had + 主语 + 过去分词），表示「不仅……而且……也」，起强调作用。本课用 Not only had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison as well 突出记者不幸的遭遇。

examples.en: Not only had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison as well.
examples.cn: 那个可怜的记者不仅被捕了，而且还被送进了监狱。

points.title: 分词作后置定语 (Participle as Post-modifier)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语置于名词后作后置定语，相当于定语从句的简化，表示主动或正在进行的动作。本课用 leading to the high wall 修饰 steps（台阶通向高墙）、surrounded the president's palace 修饰 wall，使叙述简洁。

examples.en: Hundreds of steps lead to the high wall which surrounds the president's palace'.
examples.cn: 几百级台阶通向环绕总统的高墙。

examples.en: he had been arrested while counting the 1,084 steps leading to the fifteen-foot wall which surrounded the president's palace.
examples.cn: 就在他数通向15英尺高的总统府围墙的1，084级台阶时，被抓了起来。

exercises.q: Last year a journalist ______ by a well-known magazine to write an article.
______ had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison as well.
Hundreds of steps ______ to the high wall which surrounds the president's palace.
填入与 not only 呼应的短语（两个单词）：Not only had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison ______.
